name: Giving to Scale
description: Type in a gift a very rich person made, their fortune, and your own net worth or yearly income, and see what the same share would mean for you, drawn to true scale.
problem: News of a billionaire's donation gives a dollar figure that is hard to judge; seeing it as a share of their fortune, applied to your own money, means doing the division by hand, and the size of a fortune is hard to picture at all.
